items.title: Dreams Awakened
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description:
Charge through this mysterious and jovial world, where you will help uncover a sinister plot. Help the villagers, battle creatures and bring an end to a mad scientist's evil plot.

-13 skins
-Vast outlandish map
-Solo/Co-op PvE
-Adventure/Puzzle/Collectibles

items.title: Bandanas
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Look your coolest with these amazing bandana based teen skins.

+ 12 HD teenage skins
+ Seriously cool bandanas
+ Casual clothing

items.title: Modern Streetwear
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Do you enjoy being well dressed, and like cool clothes? Modern Streetwear is the skin pack for you! The pack contains 10 unique, colorful, and fashionable skins for you to choose from. All of them are modern, and all of them are cool!

- Cool
- Colorful
- Modern fashion

By: Norvale

items.title: Hillside Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Live in luxury while having the richest modern mansion in the hills! Your new trendy house comes with tons of amazing features like a deep swimming pool, 3 dream bedrooms, storage rooms, and more for you to explore and enjoy. 

- 14 teen skins
- Great for survival 
- Starting loot

items.title: Pastel Texture Pack
items.creator: Square Dreams
items.description:
The Pastel Texture Pack will make your worlds more cheerful and vivid! 

+ Console, mobile and computer friendly
+ Cute Mobs
+ Full custom colorful UI

By Square Dreams
items.changelog:
Fully updated for Mounts of Mayhem!
+ Added Vibrant Visuals Support
+ Hundreds of Updated and Improved Textures

items.title: Parkour!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour! Use your parkour skills to make your way to the top!

items.title: Cute Modern Furniture
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Cute Modern Furniture is here to let you decorate your world with custom furniture and a cute resource pack!

+ 25 furniture pieces
+ Custom textures
+ Easy to use tools

items.title: Pro Parkour
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Are you a parkour pro? Then test your skills on the hardest parkour levels you'll ever see! This is no easy map. The jumps are difficult and will test the skills of any jumping master. Good luck!

- Hard parkour levels
- 10 levels
- Single or multiplayer compatible

items.title: Millionaire Modern Mansion!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Survive in luxury. Play in this beautiful Millionaire Modern Mansion. Nestled in a mountainous forest region, make this base your own. Take a dip in the pool or lounge in one of the many decorated rooms. Have fun today!

- Starter chest provided

items.title: Sky Parkour 2
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
100 more levels of parkour in the sky! Can you beat them all? They start out easy but get more challenging as you progress. Are you a parkour noob, or a parkour pro? Beat all 100 levels and prove that you are a true parkour master! Keep your cool and keep on jumping.

- 100 levels
- Fun designs
- Progressively challenging
- Convenient checkpoints
- Multiplayer compatible

items.title: Millionaire Island Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Survive on your private millionaire island. With a beautiful mansion, tennis court, and yacht, you'll be in true luxury! Check out all the decorated rooms and make it your own.

- Survival spawn

items.title: Teen Golfers
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Fancy a game of golf? 
Get yourself kitted out in these outfits. 
One free skin!

items.title: Titan Base
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Titan! Explore this giant space base complete with a spaceport, farms, labs and much more! Complete the quests to help out the crew and keep busy or relax and enjoy the views of your new home! 

- Huge space station
- Custom furniture
- Custom rover vehicle
- Custom quests

items.title: Friends
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description: Be the trendiest among your friends with these fashionable teen skins. Choose your best costume and rock the most stylish appearance in your Minecraft world.

items.title: TNT Plus
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Welcome to the biggest laboratory where you will get a lot of TNT to have fun alone or with your friends, but be careful, you will fight against the big TNT boss!

items.title: Anime Friends 2021
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
How many friends do you have? Meet your next best friends in this anime wonderland! With different aspirations, from gaming to hiking and shopping, they are the best of friends. Join their squad and have a fun time among the teens!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 anime-themed teen skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Demon Fashionistas
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Discover a completely new Minecraft realm! Spooky demons are coming out at night while teens enjoy their free time in the modern city. The dead of the night brings to life scary demons. Watch out for them!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 demon-themed skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Crystal Blocks
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
There are precious gems that can be found deep in the mines! Dress up as these rare ores with the 'Crystal Blocks' skin set!

- 8 different skins to choose from!
- Perfect for anyone dwelling in caves, mines, or underground fortresses!

items.title: Lost Island
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Explore forgotten territory with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Lost and adrift at sea, you succumb to exhaustion and pass out. When you awake you find yourself waist deep in water, your ship barely staying afloat. You see a shoreline, but on the horizon a massive volcano looms spouting fire and molten rocks. Will you survive?

items.title: Cool Spring
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Embrace your free spirit with these Minecraft spring-themed skins! Meet city-fashioned teens who are big fans of music, games, and anime! In their free time, these teens are doing parkour across the modern city while freeing their inner spirits and sharing their cool personalities.

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Armor Stands
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Get lucky and hide among your friends' base with these imitations of your favorite block and armor sets! With all this camo variety the sky is the limit on how many different ways you can surprise your friends!

- Includes a base armor stand skin, 6 armor skins, and 6 advanced armor skins!

items.title: Galaxy Geos
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Get the lunar look with the 'Galaxy Geos' skinset! A combination of abstract patterns and outer space designs, you'll be sure to stand out in the crowd!

- 8 different skins!
- A wide variety of neon patterns and galactic textures!

items.title: Golden Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
The new gilded rift in the northern sky unleashes a new batch of shiny terrors! These gold glitches may look fabulous and lucky but are incredibly dangerous! Gather your arms and armor and prepare to block their attacks!

- Includes 10 golden glitch skins!

items.title: Quackers
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Quack quack! Become the coolest duck around with these amazing duck skins!

+ 7 crazy duck types
+ Unique outfits
